images.caption: Figure 1:After-cost trading performancefrom 01 Jan 2020 to 31 Dec 2025. The dashed line marks the out-of-sample start. Purple shows cumulative PnL on fixed notional, orange shows a view with profits reinvested quarterly, and color indicates rolling 365-day annualized Sharpe.

Figure 2:AllocFlow from market histories to portfolio decisions.(a) Frozen Kronos yields a coarse/fine market-token pair per asset; the instrument-ID mapping connects each pair to its allocation-state token. The DiT-style flow head generates a joint target book. (b) Causal strategy allocations initialize the head through imitation. (c) A 24-hour portfolio reward and a frozen IL reference guide Flow-GRPO refinement.

Figure 3:Opposite asset-level reversals.Left: AUCTION falls from a local peak. Right: 1000PEPE rebounds from a local bottom. Black dashed lines mark price turns; blue dotted lines mark RL’s earlier change in position direction. Blue/red positions are short/long. The labels beside each panel give asset-specific PnL over the subsequent 24 hours.
